title: ONCOR Taichung
text:
ONCOR expanded beyond Taipei’s Xinyi District in July with the opening of its Taichung flagship in the city’s Seventh Redevelopment Zone, bringing together karaoke, art, dining and private entertainment.

Founded by brothers David and Alan Hsia, who established nightlife and hospitality consultancy theLOOP, the brand takes a multisensory approach to urban leisure. Marble, metal finishes, a signature fragrance and custom seating complement calibrated acoustics and Swedish lighting technology.

A stainless steel sculpture by artist Demos Chiang anchors the entrance, while chef André Chiang leads the culinary offering. His five signature noodle dishes reinterpret Taiwanese comfort food through international influences, ranging from sesame oil pork rib vermicelli to laksa and truffle sukiyaki wagyu udon. Cocktails complete the menu.

Three private suites, named Michael, Gabriel and Raphael after the archangels, accommodate groups of 20 to 45. Each features a distinct interior, from mirrored party settings to warmer, more intimate surroundings, alongside an exclusive hotpot menu.

Additional karaoke rooms use red, yellow and green palettes to create different moods, accommodating 12 to 28 guests.

Combining entertainment with dining, social gatherings and business meetings, ONCOR positions the flagship as a broader lifestyle destination. The company also plans expansion into the United States, Japan and Singapore.

fields.Location: B2, No. 120, Sec. 3, Henan Rd., Xitun Dist., Taichung City

title: ONCOR
text: ONCOR rethinks the future of private entertainment in Taiwan. Events at ONCOR promise something unique within the walls of 34 richly appointed private entertainment suites that pair luxury with state-of-the-art technology and Asian-style hospitality in a living room-like locale. Each of the private suites offers a best-in-class experience by combining award-winning lighting and design, Michelin-calibre feasts, and pioneering tech-driven fun all built upon the concept of an impossibly sleek KTV experience.

fields.Location: B2F., No. 101., Songren Rd, Xinyi District, Taipei 11073, Taiwan

title: KOR Shanghai
text: Award winning cocktail bar, Michelin caliber restaurant, and internationally recognized interior design, KOR Super Lounge exists in its own unique category.  KOR helps unify a body of influential people with an exclusively welcoming point of view. Helping them to be comfortably challenged, by exposing them to the fundamentals in order to fulfil their basic needs all in one place. With our 5 Pillars, Food, Drinks, Music, Fashion and people, as our foundation. KOR Shanghai is the preferred destination unlike any other.

fields.Location: Wheelock Square, No. 1717, Nanjing West Road, Jing An District, Shanghai

title: KOR Taipei
text:
Located in the red-hot nexus of Taipei’s entertainment district, KOR is the city’s sexy but sophisticated solution to socializing. 
The sparkling lounge attracts a well-heeled mix of well-to-do western-minded Taiwanese, affluent expatriates and multinational business tourists looking for a young-at-heart alternative to EDM-fueled nightclubs. Free from any dance floor, the lounge better encourages social stimulation coupled with specialty libations and artful cocktails built upon rare liquors and delivered with impeccable service by award-winning mixologists. Hip-hop, funk and soul flood the room through a custom designed chrome finished VOID Acoustics sound system. 
In 2017, KOR was awarded the prestigious iF Design Award in the ‘Interior Architecture: Hotels/Spas/Restaurants/Bars’ category and is the first bar in Asia to pick up the illustrious award.

fields.Location: 5F, No. 201, Zhong Xiao East Road, Section 4, Daan District, Taipei 10690, Taiwan

title: OMNI
text: OMNI is theLOOP’s latest foray into a high-end clubbing experience and is the most energizing and imitable establishment. After nearly two decades in the nightlife entertainment industry, with the fruition of dozens of music festival productions, OMNI was born as the pinnacle of theLOOP’s ever-expanding knowledge in both dance and club cultures. OMNI not only features a state-of-the-art stage found only at the best theatres, complete with a high-definition video canvas that delivers larger-than-life visual experiences, but also introduces world-class VIP bottle services incorporated with avant-garde performance art, a unique trait only to OMNI. Since launching in 2015, OMNI has been the recipients of several prolific international awards in interior design for its multi-faceted lighting scenario in a sophisticated architecture.

fields.Location: 5F, No. 201, Zhong Xiao East Road, Section 4, Daan District, Taipei 10690, Taiwan

title: ALTA
text: The name “ALTA” derives from Latin, which conveys “high” and “profound” in feminine form as simply one look at the staggering 30 feet-high ceiling immediately gives the meaning away to anyone under her towering embrace. Opened in 2018, ALTA has gone on and won the prestigious iF Design Award and highly respected Live Design Awards in the same year.

fields.Location: No. 59, Qinghai South Street, Xitun District, Taichung City, Taiwan

title: CÉ LA VI Taipei
text: Thursday April 4, 2019 (Taipei, Taiwan) Taipei looks to join the ranks of metropolitan cities like Singapore, Hong Kong, Colombo and Kuala Lumpur with the grand opening of CÉ LA VI Taipei on April 26th and 27th 2019. The new destination will welcome a mix of well-heeled locals, international guests and global business travellers to discover Taipei from a new perspective on the 48th floor of the newly opened Nanshan skyscraper, making it the highest rooftop lounge in Taiwan by more than 30 stories . The al fresco rooftop bar and restaurant is juxtaposed with sweeping 360° views of a vibrant and cool city.

fields.Location: No. 17, Songzhi Road, Xinyi District, Taipei City, Taiwan

title: LOOPTOPIA
text: Looptopia was the first homegrown electronic music festival and entertainment wonderland to take place in Taiwan and debuted in 2017 to more than 32,000 revelers. The inaugural event garnered rave reviews by local and international media who likened it to other all-encompassing and fully immersive international festivals like Mysteryland and Tomorrowland. Three years in the making, the festival spanned multiple days and saw over 50 of the world’s biggest DJs perform on three elaborately designed stages.

title: WINTER LOVE
text: Winter Love was theLOOP’s first record-breaking indoor massive dance event. The event debuted in 2005 with Paul Van Dyk to a crowd of more than 12,000 people, breaking the attendance record for a dance event in Taiwan. In 2006, the event was moved to one of Taiwan’s most popular tourist sites, the iconic CKS Memorial Hall, and became theLOOP’s first charity event with all proceeds going to Yahoo! Charities.

title: SPRING LOVE
text: Unlike most other earlier events organized by theLOOP, Spring Love opted to embrace the outdoors. Spanning four years, the franchise welcomed around 10,000 to each of its events that by utilizing mobile stages were held all over the islands at beach resorts as well as the wilderness. The brand also worked to promote tourism by partnering with hotels boasting vast open spaces that were turned into hedonistic havens of good vibes, once even turning Taiwan’s most renowned tourist site CKS Memorial Hall into a mini music paradise.

title: FANTASIA
text: theLOOP’s 10th anniversary blowout became the largest water park music festival in Asia upon its conception. Drawing inspiration from unlikely places and looking to offer its dedicated patrons an unprecedented and unique experience, the festival took place at the Formosa Fun Coast Waterpark and it fully exploited its water park location with stages built around the park’s many immense pool and waterslides. The event saw over 10,000 partygoers flood the park to help celebrate another milestone in theLOOP’s history.

title: SENSATION
text: Organized by ID&T, one of the world’s largest entertainment enterprises with events like Mysteryland and Tomorrowland operating under its umbrella, Sensation is an indoor dance event with an otherworldly and over-the-top production value with events in five continents and more than 30 countries. Upon arriving the Asia, ID&T partnered with theLOOP to provide services for the event that included everything from local and cultural know-how to governmental lobbying and venue security while ID&T provided the creative shell. The event went on to become the largest white party to ever land in Asia and the single largest dance music event in Taiwan with over 18,000 attendees and its success was the result of an ideal partnership of two prolific forces that allowed for the flawless delivery and execution of the much-anticipated Sensation Taiwan events.

title: HALLOWEEN MASSIVE
text: Halloween Massive is theLOOP’s longest running franchise and truly represents its passion for dance music coupled with lavish large scale events. The series ran for 10 years with an average attendance of 10,000+ elaborately costumed attendees, avant-garde stage performances and trendsetting international artist lineups making the annual Halloween Massive events the epitome of theLOOP spirit. Hailed as the largest costume party in Asia and welcoming revelers from every corner of the world, Halloween Massive changed the event landscape for theLOOP as it evolved into one of the most cutting-edge stage performances in Asia.

title: 2F: WHITE PARTY
text: The 2F: White Party, with its namesake paying homage to theLOOP’s first ever nightclub of the same name, evolved to become Asia’s most prestigious and longest running white-themed music event franchise. Running for 10 years with attendance regularly topping 10,000+, the event is the largest white party to ever land in Asia and the single largest dance music event in Taiwan. With its roots running strong in the trance music community, the event’s inclusive ethos spread becoming a staple summer experience for music lovers from all across Asia.

title: W HOTELS
text: Since opening in Taipei in 2011, theLOOP has been providing the W Hotel with talent, music curation and entertainment programming. In light of theLOOP’s longstanding position cultivating a music culture in Taiwan, the team was recognized by the W Hotel for having a strong eye on the local scene and is able to source and book artists to create dynamic line-ups of mood setting music. Together with the luxury boutique hotel brand, they create unique happenings distinct to Taipei and showcase some of the city’s strongest talent while providing the most exquisite nocturnal delights in the most exotic location in the city.

title: 2ND FLOOR
text: 2001 was a time when electronic music was relatively unheard of in Taiwan until 2nd Floor – later shortened to 2F – debuted and nurtured the nascent scene before infecting the country with electronic music and raves throughout its three-year span. The seminal nightclub elevated Taiwan’s electronic music scene to one with the means to host international acts and paved the way for its storied successor Luxy.

title: XAGA
text: Xaga was the go-to club in Taichung for many years and delivered an elegant and stylish clubbing experience to central Taiwan akin to that of the capital Taipei City. A true dancer’s paradise but targeting Taichung’s well-heeled, Xaga seamlessly blended glamour with style, comfort and accessibility in an atmosphere fueled by electronic music and hip-hop.

title: PRIMO
text: theLOOP’s boldest nightclub project initialized in 2007 and was Taiwan’s first nightclub to embrace VIP membership services. Primo’s atmosphere created an air of exclusivity amongst clubbers looking for luxury and prestige with its smart design and chic décor. The club was heralded by the media for its VIP oriented service and creative cocktails as well as a regular guest list of Taiwan’s trendiest crowds and Asia’s biggest celebrities.

title: SUPPERCLUB
text: supperclub is theLOOP’s boldest horizontal alliances project. Originally from the Netherlands, supperclub is widely regarded as the most avant-garde multinational corporation in the dining industry. Spotted in exotic locations such as Amsterdam, London, Istanbul, San Francisco, Singapore, and Dubai, supperclub aims to extend its unique style well into all major cities worldwide. By investing in the supperclub group, theLOOP was the founding management team and organizer of events in their newest franchise found in Los Angeles. Integrating a state-of-the-art dining experience with music, high fashion, and cutting-edge performances with top-notch service, supperclub Los Angeles established a reputation as a playground for Hollywood celebrities.

title: LUXY
text: For more than a decade, Luxy’s reputation as Asia’s most luxurious and sexy nightclub was unwavering. As the largest club in Taiwan in both its size and operation, Luxy dramatically revolutionized the clubbing industry in Taipei with its go-go spirit and elevated the city’s club scene to rival those in places like Hong Kong and Shanghai. For many years, Luxy was one of the only clubs in Taiwan to consistently host some of the world’s biggest DJs but at the same time was a hotbed for undiscovered local talent. Endlessly imitated and legendary to this day, Luxy will be forever etched into the memories of Taiwan’s youth and expatriates from all corners of the globe.

title: FOUR SEASONS HOTELS & RESORTS
text: When the Four Seasons in Beijing decided to undertake the biggest bar project in their corporate history and open an ultra lounge on their rooftop, theLOOP deployed a team of consultants with over a decade of experience in nightlife know how to oversee the planning and execution of Jia, with its namesake borrowed from the Chinese character for family, upon which the entire concept was built. The team arrived in Beijing and first analyzed the profitability of the venue, created financial forecasts along with manning costs and core team structures as well as identified the roles required to operate the venue. Brand development followed with the creation of the logo, identity, message and theme for the 3,000 sqm venue. The final phase included sound and lighting design, venue aesthetic and design improvements, conceptualizing bar menus for each room and vendor negotiation.
